changes_completed_note: Round 1 (5 of 6) DONE and pushed (814be24). 1 = dependabot-yml: new .github/dependabot.yml, 4 ecosystems (cargo, npm root, npm frontend, github-actions), weekly + grouped minor/patch. 2 = fix-uar-integration-test: Skill derives Default; added ..Default::default() to the test's Skill literal missing 8 fields. cargo check --test uar_integration clean. 3 = fix-bdd-test-path: nested #[path] resolved relative to tests/live/ instead of tests/integration/live/ since the outer mod live had no #[path] of its own; moved the prefix onto mod live itself. cargo check --test bdd clean. 4 = artifact-refiner-gate-decision: ToolSearch reconfirmed no artifact-refiner MCP tool available in this environment at all; wrote D-E decision record (.kbd-orchestrator/references/artifact-refiner-gate-decision.md) formally retiring the gate requirement, documenting the cargo check/test/clippy + direct-inspection methods already used as the replacement. 5 = npm-deps-triage: BOTH alerts fully resolved (better than plan.md's disclosed 'may end in traced, no action possible' risk). jsonwebtoken alert was actually against tools/uar-jwt-proxy/Cargo.toml (Rust, not npm as assessment.md assumed) -- pinned '9' resolved to vulnerable 9.3.1 in Cargo.lock alongside the rest of the workspace's patched 10.4.0; bumped to '10', Cargo.lock now resolves a single 10.4.0 workspace-wide. dompurify@3.4.7 traced to @types/dompurify, a completely unused (zero imports) root devDependency; removed it, dompurify no longer appears in pnpm-lock.yaml. Checkpoint: cargo check --workspace clean, cargo test --lib 363/363 green, frontend tsc --noEmit shows the same 17 pre-existing errors unchanged. 6 = fix-waypoint-stage-schema: RESOLVED after user decision (AskUserQuestion: fix at the source in the separate repo). Fixed shared/scripts/write-position-reminder.sh AND write-session-summary.sh (identical bug found in the second file while fixing the first) in prometheus-skill-system, changing `.stage // "unknown"` to `.stage // .status // "unknown"`. Rebased onto origin/main (20 unrelated upstream commits, none conflicting) rather than force-pushing; pushed as commit 91006b8. Verified against a synthetic .status-only waypoint (no .stage) -- confirms the actual regression scenario is fixed, not just the happy path. Round 1 now fully complete, 6/6. 7 = wasmtime-disposition (720ba17): user asked for latest, so bumped wasmtime/wasmtime-wasi 41.0.3->46 (resolves 46.0.1) rather than the plan's documented-risk fallback -- satisfies all open CVEs (needed >=42.0.2/43.0.2/44.0.2). Broke exactly one thing: wasmtime::Error no longer implements std::error::Error in 46.x, so anyhow's Context stopped applying to wasmtime Results at 6 call sites (wasm_runtime.rs x3, sandbox.rs x3); swapped to wasmtime's own wasmtime::error::Context trait (no disambiguation needed, every .context() call in both files was on a wasmtime Result). Also removed a deprecated no-op Config::async_support(true) call. Verified: cargo check --features wasm-runtime clean (was 6 errors), cargo check --tests --features wasm-runtime clean, cargo test --lib --features wasm-runtime 367/367 green, cargo clippy --features wasm-runtime zero new warnings, default cargo check --lib (feature off) unaffected. 8 = run-hot-path-bench (38f285b): cargo check --benches confirmed compiles (never checked before); cargo bench --bench hot_path ran for real (35min first-time release build), all 4 benchmarks microsecond-scale or better (prompt_dialect_detect ~1.81us, strategy_for_model ~82.1ns, apply_strategy_sliding_window_500_messages ~134.9us, model_router_route ~341.2us), no red flags. Baseline recorded durably in benches/hot_path.rs's own doc comment. Round 2 now fully complete, 2/2. 9 = rmcp-pin-bump (c90858e): bumped rmcp from a pre-1.4.0 git rev to rmcp-v1.8.0 tag, fixing GHSA-89vp-x53w-74fx (high severity DNS-rebinding in the Streamable HTTP server transport, which this project directly enables -- transport-streamable-http-server(-session) features are on, so this was a real exposure). A separate transitive rmcp@1.7.0 via kreuzberg was already patched. Broke 9 call sites (Tool, CallToolRequestParams, Implementation, ServerInfo, StreamableHttpServerConfig all became #[non_exhaustive] -- confirmed via rustc --explain E0639 that ..Default::default() does NOT bypass this, unlike wasmtime's Context trait issue; fixed via each type's provided constructor/builder instead). Verified: cargo check (default + wasm-runtime feature) clean, cargo test --lib 363/363, cargo test --test test_mcp_optional 4/4, cargo test --test integration 56/56 (incl. real MCP tool-call round trip), cargo clippy zero new warnings. Remaining: Round 4 (surrealdb-upgrade, own checkpoint, highest blast radius, last change in the phase).
